episode.title: I Spent 50 Hours In Solitary Confinement — Cartoons in Reality
episode.logline: Jimmy locks himself in a white room for 50 hours. The boys try everything to get him out. The room is real. The five are cartoons. Jimmy wins — and the boys get slimed.

audioTimeline.note: For this episode only — "I Spent 50 Hours In Solitary Confinement" (crew-5): the voice track is the real footage audio at each shot's videoTimeSeconds — the real people speaking in MrBeast's video at that shot's moment, by Nick's explicit direction (Nov 10, 2026). No synthetic voices, no voice cloning, and no dialogue lines are produced in voice slots. The synthetic tone cues (whoosh / sparkle / thud and the other studio tones) are sound effects only, mixed at their cue seconds on top of the footage audio. Music files come from the user's own licensed/free library; the studio ships no music.
audioTimeline.voiceTrack: Real footage audio at each shot's videoTimeSeconds — the real audio from MrBeast's video at that shot's moment. No synthetic voices, no voice cloning.

frames.note: One PNG per shot, in timeline order; each is held for its shot's durationSeconds by the assembly step.

assembly.perShot: ffmpeg -loop 1 -t <shot durationSeconds> -i episode-frames/shot-%03d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p scene-<scene>-shot-<shot>.mp4
assembly.audio: Voice track: the real footage audio — for each shot, take the audio from MrBeast's video at that shot's videoTimeSeconds and lay it under that shot, so the voices are the real people speaking in the footage itself, by Nick's explicit direction (Nov 10, 2026). No synthetic voices, no voice cloning, and no dialogue lines are produced in voice slots for this episode. Sound effects only: mix each soundCues entry at its atSeconds (ffmpeg adelay + amix) and each audioTimeline soundEffects entry at its atSecondsInEpisode — the synthetic tone cues (whoosh / sparkle / thud and the other studio tones) are sound effects only. Lay the music slot's file (supplied from the user's own licensed/free library — the studio ships no music) from its startSeconds at its volume, under everything.
assembly.preview: The studio's Play preview is compressed; this EDL's seconds are exact.

realism: Event effects in episode frames are drawn/stylised cartoon effects, labelled as such in the Event Library — not photoreal. The CG style path models gradient light on every form; the 3D stage is real geometry with one key light.
boundary: This episode uses the actual footage of MrBeast's I Spent 50 Hours In Solitary Confinement (video r7zJ8srwwjk) by Nick's explicit direction for this video only (Nov 10, 2026). The five cartoon characters replace the real people entirely — not a face swap, not a deepfake — and the room stays the real footage. The voices are the real people speaking in the footage itself — the real audio from MrBeast's video at each shot's moment, by Nick's explicit direction (Nov 10, 2026). No synthetic voices, no voice cloning. Every other episode follows the studio rule: templates hold blocking, camera and timing only — no footage, no real person's face or likeness, no face swap. Casting uses only the studio's fictional characters; styles are stylised parody figures.
